name: reloadex
description: Reloadex - Pokédex profesional de Pokémon Reloaded (datos fieles al juego; app móvil/APK ready)

scripts.build:data: node scripts/buildAbilities.mjs && node scripts/buildReloadexData.mjs && node scripts/buildLearnsets.mjs && node scripts/buildObjectLocations.mjs && node scripts/buildQuests.mjs && node scripts/buildFaces.mjs
scripts.build:all: node scripts/buildAbilities.mjs && node scripts/buildReloadexData.mjs && node scripts/buildLearnsets.mjs && node scripts/buildObjectLocations.mjs && node scripts/buildQuests.mjs && node scripts/buildFaces.mjs && node scripts/buildGuideData.mjs && vite build
scripts.apk:prepare: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/prepareApkBuild.mjs
scripts.apk:debug: npm run apk:prepare && node scripts/runGradle.mjs assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.apk:release: npm run apk:prepare && node scripts/runGradle.mjs assembleRelease --no-daemon -x :capacitor-android:extractReleaseAnnotations -x :capacitor-cordova-android-plugins:extractReleaseAnnotations -x :capacitor-android:lintVitalAnalyzeRelease -x :capacitor-cordova-android-plugins:lintVitalAnalyzeRelease -x :app:lintVitalAnalyzeRelease -x :app:lintVitalReportRelease -x :app:lintVitalRelease
scripts.release:update: npm run build && npm run update:bundle
